text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Feng Shui Umamusume, Copano Rickey. 
Her challenge for the Twinkle Series 
alongside her Trainer has begun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey's dream is to spread Feng 
Shui and make everyone happy. To do that, 
she must first demonstrate the power of 
Feng Shui herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Believing that winning races using feng 
shui tactics would surely help spread the 
word about feng shui— she decided to 
pursue the dirt route that suited her 
best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the generation above in dirt racing, 
there are Hokko Tarumae and Wonder Acute. 
Eventually, she will have to face them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are still people who dismiss feng 
shui as mere occultism. Even so, she will 
prove them wrong on the track and achieve 
her dream.
